_doc: PLAN.md 4.3, Phase 3.3. How the flight controller turns a stick into thruster throttles. Units: U, seconds, radians. Top speed in a direction is push / (mass x linear_damp).

camera._doc: Follow camera (3.5). The ship's longest side takes ship_screen_share of the screen height at rest; the view zooms out by speed_zoom_out per U/s, down to min_zoom_share of that. It leads the ship by look_ahead_s of its velocity.

sandbox._doc: Flight sandbox extras (4.2): start_target (a practice target from data/enemies) is parked ahead at the start. The Spawn button (owner, 2026-10-26) lists every ship to spawn: practice targets, the roster, the carrier and the player's own ships. An enemy appears spawn_gap_u ahead of the player's ship (owner, 2026-10-26: twice as far as the first 6 U), turned spawn_facing_deg from the player (one without thrusters, a practice target, target_rotation_deg); a roster ship flies itself (5.2). The carrier (the roster's ally) appears carrier_beside_u to the player's right, pointing the same way, and flies carrier_route round and round (laid out in the player's frame at spawn: x ahead, y to the right); enemies go for whichever of the player and the carrier is nearer, the carrier's distance counted at carrier_bias, so they make for it (an escort mission, 12.3). A tap on any ship's tile highlights it, and hits it for test_hit raw damage of test_hit_type (0 since the guns arrived in 4.3). The player's ship comes back respawn_s after it's destroyed. The Guns button steps a Creative ship's guns through gun_levels (4.3); a stocked ship's guns are inventory items at their own levels, and a single spawned enemy comes at encounter_level (its guns about 10x that, at the level's damage share, levels.json), and a kill earns XP and pay at the enemy's own level (4.8b, 4.8c). The Spawn list's encounter_buttons spawn a generated fight at that level, and hvt_buttons a Kill HVT one led by a boss (5.3).

combat_hud._doc: Phase 4.7. A hit on the player flashes the screen (red for hull, blue for shield only) for flash_s, at up to flash_alpha. Screen shake jolts the view by shake_px_per_damage per point of damage, up to shake_max_px, settling at shake_decay per second. A hull hit of at least vibrate_min_damage buzzes the phone for vibrate_ms. Both obey the Controls settings.

arena._doc: The flight sandbox's bounds (3.5): a square of half_size_u around the start. Inside warn_margin_u of the edge the HUD warns; past the edge a push of push_back U/s^2 per U of depth steers the ship back. Story mode replaces the push with the world map (4.10).
